{{Quote|A decade ago, I served under Moff Broysc at the Battle of Druckenwell. Moff Broysc made a critical oversight that brought the fleet to the brink of complete defeat. I ignored his order and turned the tide to victory.|Captain Malavai Quinn, to the Empire's Wrath|<ref name="Quinn's Grudge" />}}
The '''Battle of Druckenwell''' was a conflict during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Occurring in the last months of the war in [[3653 BBY]], the battle saw combat between Republic and Imperial fleets,<ref name="Quinn's Grudge" /> with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] later known as the [[Eagle]] serving as an Imperial starfighter pilot<ref name="The Eagle's Nest" /> and at least one [[Archival Node 803-A|Imperial transport]] ruined during the battle.<ref name="The Watchful Eye" /> The Imperial commanding officer, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Broysc]], made a critical oversight that nearly resulted in defeat, but one of his subordinates&mdash;a man named [[Malavai Quinn]]&mdash;chose to disobey the Moff's order and single-handedly returned the advantage to the Empire, resulting in a Republic defeat.<ref name="Quinn's Grudge" />

However, Broysc was furious at the insubordination from Quinn, who had been tracking a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] agent by the name of [[Voloren]] and had the other man cornered when Broysc recalled Quinn to serve in the battle. The Moff took credit for Quinn's saving of the fleet, but chose to court-martial his subordinate. Fortunately for Quinn, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] assigned Quinn to [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], leaving Broysc to fume and block every transfer or promotion Quinn received during his time on the planet.<ref name="Quinn's Grudge" />
